description:
Activate Morselhoarder by paying {1}{U}, blinking it. Morselhoarder will enter with two -1/-1 counters on it due to its ability.
When Morselhoarder enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Morselhoarder.
Activate Morselhoarder twice by removing two -1/-1 counters from it, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.
